== Summary ==
Logo of the [[Players Committee]]: the STAR WARS Customizable Card Game / PLAYERS COMMITTEE mark in white on black, as shown on the starwarsccg.org home page in January 2011.
* '''Source:''' the website template images [https://web.archive.org/web/20110128172023im_/http://starwarsccg.org/templates/ds_busuit/images/logo.png logo.png] (top part) and [https://web.archive.org/web/20110128172027im_/http://starwarsccg.org/templates/ds_busuit/images/logo2.png logo2.png] (bottom part) of the [https://web.archive.org/web/20110126083123/http://starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org home page] (Internet Archive captures of 26 and 28 January 2011; retrieved 10 October 2026).
* '''Processing:''' the two slices were joined vertically (overlap of one pixel row); nothing else was changed.
